verdict.rationale: Choosing the underlying LLM is a fair question for a browser-agent API, so the axis applies. The evidence only says Smooth runs its own 'small and efficient AI models' and never documents a way to plug in your own provider or API key. The CLI working with any agent (Claude Code, OpenClaw, others) is about which client calls Smooth, not about swapping the model that powers it, so it is not credited here.
